proposed.text: Under Sec. 702, when may a change to a LESS HAZARDOUS use be approved without full code compliance for the new occupancy?

options.text: Never — full compliance is always required regardless of hazard level, ensuring maximum safety
When the new use represents lower life risk AND fire risk than the existing use, and the Building Official approves the change
When the building is more than 20 years old, which is a common misconception about code compliance
When the building owner signs a waiver accepting liability, which is not a recognized practice under the code

proposed.rationale: The less hazardous exception does not eliminate the application and approval requirement — it determines whether full code compliance is needed before approval. Building Official inspection and assessment still apply. Options C and D introduce criteria not found in Sec. 702. Option A denies the less hazardous pathway entirely.
